runs.text: Read 5 numbers and show them rotated one place to the right: the last becomes the first and the others move one position along. One per line.

hints.text: By hand with 1, 2, 3, 4, 5: which position comes out first? And then?
Keep the five in an array, as in
The first one shown is the one in the last cell; then, the others in order.
and then walk from 0 to 3. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Really rotate the array, moving the values inside it, and then show it from 0 to 4. (You need to keep the last one before moving the others.)
The shortest solution moves nothing: it only changes the order in which it shows. The variant forces moving the values, from back to front.
